The difference between the power law and Voce laws are that there is continuous work hardening with plastic strain increases with the former, while there is stress saturation at large strain for the latter. The results of the fitting for the flow curves can be seen in Fig. 10, where the triangular symbols are the flow curves extracted from tensile test results, and the solid lines and the fitting from Ludwik law or voce law. It can be seen that both the Ludwik law and Voce law have good fitting for the experimental ones.
